messages.text: Hi Professor Alvarez — good to see you earlier. Following up on the hallway chat: since your faculty senate meeting is cancelled this week, would Wednesday 10:00–10:30am work for a 30-minute meeting? I'll put it on your calendar if that hour is still fine.

Hello — this is Professor Alvarez. Diego tells me my faculty senate meeting is cancelled, and I'd like to give him Wednesday 10:00-10:30 for a 30-minute meeting. Could you confirm: is the faculty senate slot (Wednesdays 10:00-11:00) cancelled this week only, or for next week too? I'm filling in next week's schedule now. Thank you.

Hello, Professor Alvarez.

According to the official schedule I hold, the Faculty Senate is on next week as well: Wednesday 10:00–11:00. Nothing on next week's schedule has been cancelled, so that slot is **not free** — a meeting with Diego at 10:00–10:30 would collide with it.

I can't speak to what Diego was told, and I don't arrange meetings for anyone; I can only give you the official schedule. If you want a Wednesday slot, the only free one I can confirm from the published schedule is Wednesday 11:00–14:00 (between Faculty Senate and the Department meeting at 14:00).

Hi Diego — good to hear from you. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works on my side in principle; I'm just checking with the department office that the slot is free next week before I write it in. Consider it pencilled in — I'll confirm shortly.

Hello — Diego here (CSE455, Prof. Alvarez's student). Could you confirm whether Wednesday 10:00–10:30am is free in the department's official schedule this week, and next week too? Prof. Alvarez and I want to put a 30-minute meeting there and I'd like to make sure nothing official sits in that slot.

Hello, Diego.

No — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is not free in either week. The Faculty Senate occupies Wednesdays 10:00–11:00, both this week and next week; nothing in the official schedule is cancelled.

I only hold the department's official schedule and I don't arrange meetings, so please check with Professor Alvarez directly for anything outside it.

Understood — Wednesday 10:00–11:00 taken, and I've noted 12:30–14:00 as yours. I don't keep private appointments, so the published schedule stays as it is.
Thank you — that's clear and it settles it. I'll take the meeting out of that slot and check directly with Professor Alvarez.

Professor — the department office just told me Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is *not* free: the Faculty Senate holds Wednesdays 10:00–11:00, both this week and next, and nothing in the official schedule is cancelled. So I don't want to put the meeting there. Would another half hour this week or next work for you? I'll write it in as soon as you say a time.

Next week — I was filling in next week's schedule, sorry for the ambiguity.

But I have to un-pencil it: the department office has just confirmed to me that the Faculty Senate is **on** next week, Wednesday 10:00-11:00, and that nothing on next week's schedule is cancelled. So 10:00-10:30 next Wednesday collides with it. Whoever told you it was cancelled had it wrong, or meant a different week — worth checking with them.

Wednesday 12:30-13:00 it is — writing it in now and confirming in a moment.
Perfect — thank you. Wednesday 12:30–13:00 next week, then; I have it on my side too. See you then.
Confirmed: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00** next week, 30 minutes. It's written into my calendar, and I'll tell the department office to note the time as mine so nobody else claims it. See you then.
